calculator.policy: Pre-check only. Gaps are conflicts between a judgment overall and an estimated, unverified formula. Attributes were not shifted to force a match.

rows.style_profile: Gridiron Standard. Cannon-arm developmental starter: throw power is the carried trait, 2025 accuracy and turnovers are not, and the frame can run some.
rows.basis: Preserved AWR 62, THP 92, SAC 64. 2025 DAL 15/24, 183 yards, 1 TD, 2 INT, 50 rush yards, PFF 52.7; 2024 NE 22/29, 241 yards, 1 TD, 0 INT. 6-5, 235. Missing traits sit with the low accuracy anchor, not the earlier team-room SAC 74 / THP 97. SPD 82 is the prior team-room band for a 4.6-range athlete, which this card did not override.

rows.style_profile: Gridiron Standard. Tall rhythm backup: timing and ball protection ahead of escape, and the card's accuracy sits below the earlier team-room figure.
rows.basis: Preserved AWR 68, THP 84, SAC 72 (the current card is stricter than research-inbox/teams/PHI/QB/tanner_mckee.json SAC 80). 2024 PHI 30/45, 4 TD, 0 INT; 2025 PHI 24/43, 1 TD, 1 INT, PFF 61.2. Team-room 2026 note: pressured EPA -1.14 and a 1.3% turnover-worthy rate, so BSK stays poor and TUP does not. 6-6, 230. No new 90.

rows.style_profile: Gridiron Standard. Rookie dual-threat with no NFL snaps: college production is context, not an NFL grade, and the run traits lead the passing traits.
rows.basis: Rookie shrink. Preserved AWR 58 and THP 80. College PFF 95.9 is an FCS grade and is not copied onto any trait. Repo team-room file cites 2025 NDSU 161/224, 16 TD/4 INT, 136 carries for 777 yards, and a 4.56 forty at 232 pounds, plus a high college sack rate. Athleticism follows that file; accuracy stays under the preserved arm and awareness.

rows.style_profile: Gridiron Standard. Feature back whose speed, burst, and ball security are still on the card, with receiving and availability as the lesser traits.
rows.basis: Preserved SPD 89, ACC 88, CAR 88, BCV 80, INJ 66. Missing traits taken from the approved team-room revision research-inbox/teams/PHI/RB/saquon_barkley.revision-A2-t52s464.json, which matches those anchors. That revision set INJ 78; the current card still stores 66, so 66 stays. 2023-25 packet: 2005 yards in 2024, 1140 and PFF 67.9 in 2025. No new 90.

rows.style_profile: Gridiron Standard. Undersized speed back: the carried 90 speed and acceleration are not matched by power or vision.
rows.basis: Preserved SPD 90 and ACC 90. The team-room file had 93/93; those were not copied. Other traits follow research-inbox/teams/PHI/RB/jaydon_blue.json (5-9, 200; 2025 DAL 38 carries, 3.39 yards per carry, stuff rate 39.5%, PFF 56.9). No additional 90.

rows.style_profile: Gridiron Standard. Change-of-pace and special-teams back: quick feet and check-down hands, not a power runner, with a reserve injury tag.
rows.basis: Preserved SPD 88 and CTH 72. The team-room file had SPD 84 and CTH 70; the current card is higher and wins. ACC set level with the preserved speed. Other traits follow research-inbox/teams/PHI/RB/will_shipley.json. Packet: 2024 30 carries, 82 yards; 2025 14 carries, 49 yards; PFF 54.9. Roster status RES.

rows.note: Complete card left unchanged. Gridiron Standard audit, not an EA rating.

rows.style_profile: Gridiron Standard. Contested and jump-ball receiver whose catch traits lead his route traits, on a modest target volume.
rows.basis: Preserved SPD 86, CTH 84, CIT 86, JMP 88. Packet: 2023 GB 39/581/4, 2024 39/415/5, 2025 30/332/2, PFF 70.2. 6-1, 208. CIT already above CTH, so the profile stays contested rather than separator. No new 90.

rows.style_profile: Gridiron Standard. Rookie separator with no NFL snaps: burst and agility lead, play strength and awareness do not, and the college grade is not an NFL trait.
rows.basis: Rookie shrink. Preserved SPD 88, ACC 90, AGI 88, CTH 78. College PFF 90.8 is not copied. 5-11, 192. Routes sit under the athletic traits. ACC 90 was already on the card and is not a new elite trait from the college grade.

rows.style_profile: Gridiron Standard. Low-volume depth receiver: enough speed to be on the card, without a route or contested-catch specialty yet.
rows.basis: Preserved SPD 86 and CTH 74. Packet: 2025 PHI 6 games, 9 catches, 92 yards, PFF 61.0. 5-11, 210, one NFL season. Traits cluster with that volume. No 90.

rows.note: Complete card left unchanged. Gridiron Standard audit, not an EA rating.

rows.style_profile: Gridiron Standard. Rookie receiving tight end: speed and hands lead, blocking is unproven, and the college grade is not an NFL grade.
rows.basis: Rookie shrink. Preserved SPD 84 and CTH 76. College PFF 81.6 is not copied. No NFL regular-season line. 6-4, 239. Blocking traits stay below the receiving traits.

rows.style_profile: Gridiron Standard. Veteran inline tight end: run blocking and strength are the card, receiving volume is not.
rows.basis: Preserved STR 78, CTH 70, RBK 78. Packet: 2023 MIN 17/172/1, 2024 19/142/2, 2025 JAX 9/111/0, PFF 59.6. 6-4, 245, 9 years. Routes and speed stay under the blocking traits.

rows.style_profile: Gridiron Standard. Depth receiving tight end: ordinary hands, light blocking, and a low 2025 grade on a small target count.
rows.basis: Preserved CTH 72. Packet: 2024 24/298/1, 2025 9 games, 9/76/1, PFF 50.5. 6-4, 240. Blocking stays under the catch trait. INJ 70 reflects 3 games in 2023 and 9 in 2025, not a named diagnosis.

rows.note: Complete card left unchanged. Gridiron Standard audit, not an EA rating.

rows.style_profile: Gridiron Standard. Veteran swing tackle: size and experience ahead of feet, pass protection a shade over run blocking. Also listed at RG and RT on the depth chart; this is the one LT card.
rows.basis: Preserved STR 84, PBK 74, RBK 72. Packet: 2025 PFF 58.9, 626 offensive snaps; 2024 481; 2023 35. 6-7, 326, 7 years, 17 games in each of 2023-25. Splits stay next to the preserved blocking grades. No 90.

rows.style_profile: Gridiron Standard. Rookie right tackle with no NFL snaps: mass and a slight run lean, not feet or recognition. College grade is not an NFL grade. Also the third left tackle on the depth chart.
rows.basis: Rookie shrink. Preserved STR 84, PBK 70, RBK 72. College PFF 70.3 is not copied. No NFL snaps. 6-9, 346. Anchor traits sit above the foot traits. No 90.

rows.style_profile: Gridiron Standard. Power run guard: the carried strength and run-block grades lead the pass-protection grades.
rows.basis: Preserved STR 92, AWR 78, PBK 76, RBK 84. Packet: PFF 67.8; offensive snaps 1046, 996, then 836. 6-6, 332. Run splits stay above pass splits. STR 92 was already on the card. No new 90. INJ 78 is the snap trend, not a named injury.

rows.style_profile: Gridiron Standard. Undersized depth guard: preserved agility and a modest pass-block grade, with no public grade and no NFL stat line. Anchor stays under the feet.
rows.basis: Preserved AGI 78 and PBK 68. No PFF grade and no 2023-25 stat line. 5-11, 290. Other traits are a role band around overall 62, with feet above anchor. LOW sample. No 90.

rows.style_profile: Gridiron Standard. Small-sample center: preserved awareness and a slight pass-protection lean, on 89 offensive snaps.
rows.basis: Preserved AWR 74, PBK 72, RBK 70. Packet: 2025 7 games, 89 offensive snaps, PFF 61.8. 6-4, 308. Pass splits stay next to PBK 72 and run splits next to RBK 70. STR 80 is a size band, not a measured bench. No 90.

rows.style_profile: Gridiron Standard. Deep backup center with no public grade and no NFL stat line. The preserved pass-block grade is ordinary, and the rest sits under Drew Kendall.
rows.basis: Preserved PBK 64. No PFF grade and no 2023-25 stat line. 6-3, 306. Other traits are a role band around overall 58, at or under that pass-block grade and under Kendall. LOW sample. No 90.

rows.style_profile: Gridiron Standard. Full-time right guard whose 2025 snap count and grade lead the interior backups, without an elite trait.
rows.basis: Preserved STR 86, AWR 74, PBK 76, RBK 78. Packet: 2025 PFF 73.3 and 1009 offensive snaps after 316 and 71 in the prior two years. 6-6, 321. 17 games in 2024 and 2025. Splits stay next to the preserved grades. No 90.

rows.style_profile: Gridiron Standard. Rookie heavy guard with no NFL snaps: mass over feet, and the college grade is not an NFL blocking grade.
rows.basis: Rookie shrink. Preserved STR 80 only. College PFF 73.1 is not copied onto a blocking grade. PBK 60 and RBK 62 are new role bands under that strength, not prior card values. 6-5, 334. Feet well below the anchor. No 90.

rows.style_profile: Gridiron Standard. Speed rusher: the carried burst and finesse lead, power and block-shed do not. Card name Nolan Smith is the same player.
rows.basis: Preserved SPD 90, ACC 92, PMV 74, FMV 82. Packet under Nolan Smith Jr.: 2024 6.5 sacks, 2025 12 games, 31 tackles, 3 sacks, 11 quarterback hits, PFF 70.4. 6-2, 235. Power traits stay under the finesse traits. No new 90. Alias of Nolan Smith.

rows.style_profile: Gridiron Standard. Assignment edge whose grade held up better than his 2025 sack count. Not a power end and not Nolan Smith's athlete.
rows.basis: Preserved SPD 86 and FMV 76. Packet: 6 sacks in 2023, 6 in 2024, 2 sacks and 6 quarterback hits in 2025, PFF 74.9. 6-3, 256. Recognition and tackling sit above the sack line. No 90.

rows.style_profile: Gridiron Standard. Veteran power-and-technique edge: the preserved pass-rush grades lead, speed does not, and 2025 was a sack drop from the prior two years.
rows.basis: Preserved STR 84, AWR 78, PMV 82, FMV 80. Packet: 12.5 sacks in 2023, 12 in 2024, 2025 12 games, 3 sacks, 10 tackles for loss, 12 quarterback hits, PFF 74.3. 6-3, 263. No new 90. INJ 74 is the 12-game 2025, not a named injury.

rows.style_profile: Gridiron Standard. Developing speed edge: 2025 pressure volume above the grade, power and recognition behind the pursuit.
rows.basis: Preserved SPD 86 and FMV 74. Packet: 2025 17 games, 51 tackles, 6.5 sacks, 9 tackles for loss, 24 quarterback hits, PFF 67.3. 6-3, 252. Pursuit above power. No 90.

rows.style_profile: Gridiron Standard. Heavy power end: strength and the preserved power move lead, finesse and speed do not.
rows.basis: Preserved STR 86 and PMV 78. Packet: 6.5 and 6 sacks in 2023-24, 2025 2.5 sacks, 2 tackles for loss, 9 quarterback hits, PFF 58.9. 6-6, 280. Finesse stays under the power traits. No 90.

rows.style_profile: Gridiron Standard. Explosive interior penetrator: preserved power move, strength, and acceleration lead a down 2025 grade. Not a nose.
rows.basis: Preserved ACC 84, STR 90, AWR 78, PMV 86. Packet: 6 sacks as a rookie, 4.5 in 2024, 2025 12 games, 3 sacks, 5 tackles for loss, PFF 55.1. 6-3, 314. The down grade is why recognition and injury stay under the preserved pass-rush traits. STR 90 and PMV 86 were already on the card. No new 90.

rows.style_profile: Gridiron Standard. Nose: preserved strength and block-shed lead, speed and finesse do not. The 2025 tackle count is the on-field evidence for the run traits.
rows.basis: Preserved STR 96, BSH 88, PMV 72. Packet: 2025 17 games, 70 tackles, 4.5 sacks, 9 tackles for loss, PFF 73.9, after lighter 2023-24 tackle counts. 6-6, 336. STR 96 was already on the card. No new 95 or 90. FMV stays well under PMV.

rows.style_profile: Gridiron Standard. Interior rusher coming off a 6-sack season: power move leads finesse, and the build is lighter than Jordan Davis.
rows.basis: Preserved STR 84 and PMV 78. Packet: 2025 17 games, 38 tackles, 6 sacks, 6 tackles for loss, 12 quarterback hits, PFF 70.6, after little 2023-24 production. 6-3, 292. No 90.

rows.style_profile: Gridiron Standard. Eagles defensive tackle, Alabama, not the Rams edge. Rotational interior with a poor 2025 grade and a modest sack total.
rows.basis: New card. There was no PHI DT overall on the depth chart. Judgment overall 61, below Moro Ojomo 70. Packet: 2025 PHI 14 games, 35 tackles, 2.5 sacks, 3 tackles for loss, 4 quarterback hits, PFF 49.5; 2023 LV 3 games, 4 tackles. Repo supplement byron-young-phi-supplement-t46u.json separates gsis 00-0038978 / YounBy00 from the Rams edge 00-0039137. Registry biographical match for this id is 6-3, 292. STR 84 matches that size band and Ojomo's preserved strength, while the rush traits stay lower. No 90. The LEDGE 81 card was not edited.

rows.style_profile: Gridiron Standard. Athletic first-year mike: speed and zone tackling lead, pass rush does not.
rows.basis: Preserved SPD 88, ACC 88, TAK 78, ZCV 74. Packet: 2025 16 games, 78 tackles, 0 sacks, 2 tackles for loss, 1 INT, 3 passes defensed, PFF 76.2. 6-3, 235. PRS stays low because the sack line is empty. No new 90.

rows.style_profile: Gridiron Standard. Low-snap thumper: tackling and strength lead athleticism. The 2025 grade is not treated as an 82-overall trait because the counting stats are small.
rows.basis: Preserved STR 78 and TAK 80. Packet: 2025 13 games, 31 tackles, 0 sacks, 1 tackle for loss, 0 INT, PFF 82.1; 2024 25 tackles. 6-0, 225. Awareness stays under the grade because the tackle count is a limited sample. No 90.

rows.note: Complete card left unchanged. Gridiron Standard audit, not an EA rating.

rows.style_profile: Gridiron Standard. Athletic will linebacker whose 2025 grade and production are far below the preserved speed.
rows.basis: Preserved SPD 86 and TAK 74. Packet: 2025 8 games, 11 tackles, no sacks, tackles for loss, interceptions, or passes defensed, PFF 34.0. 6-2, 225. Skill traits stay near that grade. No new 90.

rows.note: Complete card left unchanged. Gridiron Standard audit, not an EA rating.

rows.style_profile: Gridiron Standard. Long speed corner: preserved speed and jump lead a down 2025 grade. Agility is not the same trait as that speed. Alias Tariq Woolen.
rows.basis: Preserved SPD 92, MCV 78, PRS 76, JMP 90. Packet: 2023-25 interceptions 2, 3, 1 and passes defensed 11, 14, 12; 2025 PFF 59.8. 6-4, 210. ACC stays under 90 because there is no separate acceleration cite. No new 90.

rows.style_profile: Gridiron Standard. Veteran slot: preserved agility and zone lead, long speed and press do not, and the tackle line is part of the job.
rows.basis: Preserved AGI 86, COD 86, MCV 78, ZCV 80. Packet: 2025 55 tackles, 1.5 sacks, 3 tackles for loss, 1 INT, 6 passes defensed, PFF 66.7, after higher tackle counts in 2023-24. 5-9, 190, 9 years. No 90.

rows.style_profile: Gridiron Standard. Veteran outside corner: preserved speed and awareness sit above a poor 2025 grade and ordinary ball production.
rows.basis: Preserved SPD 88, AWR 84, MCV 76. Packet: 2025 11 games, 41 tackles, 1 sack, 0 INT, 5 passes defensed, PFF 50.9. 5-10, 190, 10 years. Zone and hands stay under the preserved man and awareness grades. No 90.

rows.style_profile: Gridiron Standard. First-year free safety: preserved speed and a real interception count, with the grade and play strength still modest.
rows.basis: Preserved SPD 88, ACC 88, ZCV 76, TAK 74. Packet: 2025 11 games, 43 tackles, 0.5 sacks, 2 tackles for loss, 2 INT, 3 passes defensed, PFF 57.6. 5-11, 186. Ball skills sit above the grade and below an elite trait. No 90.

rows.note: Complete card left unchanged. Gridiron Standard audit, not an EA rating.

rows.style_profile: Gridiron Standard. Veteran box safety: preserved awareness, zone, and tackling lead speed and man coverage. The 2025 grade is a down year on limited games.
rows.basis: Preserved AWR 82, ZCV 76, TAK 80. Packet: 2024 3 games, 2025 9 games, 21 tackles, 0 INT, PFF 51.8. 6-0, 198, 7 years. New traits do not pretend the down year is an athlete prime. No 90.

rows.style_profile: Gridiron Standard. Veteran kicker: preserved accuracy and power stay, including through a down 2025 field-goal year. Availability is ordinary for a kicker who played every week, not a new 90.
rows.basis: Preserved KPW 84, KAC 88, AWR 80. Packet: 2023 30/32, long 61; 2024 28/36, long 50; 2025 20/27, long 58, XP 41/42, PFF 57.4. 17 games each year. The accuracy trait was already on the card and was not cut to chase the estimated kicker formula. No new 90.

rows.note: Complete card left unchanged. Gridiron Standard audit, not an EA rating.

rows.style_profile: Gridiron Standard. Rookie long snapper with no public grade and no NFL stat line. Applicable traits are the long-snapper set, not receiver traits.
rows.basis: Preserved AWR 70. Applicable LS traits from config/position-metrics.json: AWR, STR, RBK, PBK, SPD, TAK. The prior partial card also had CTH 68, which is not a long-snapper input and is removed from the card; the value is recorded here so it is not lost. No PFF grade and no 2023-25 stat line. 6-3, 231. Other traits are a role band around overall 64. LOW sample. No published LS overall archetype, so the calculator has nothing to check.
